string.text: GUI
HUD Controls
Hide BHS, status icons, minimap, and companion bars by default. Hold a key or a condition below to show them.
BHS
Hide BHS by default (body, limbs, psy, rads, stam)
Hide body, limbs, psy, rad, and stamina until a key, damage, or a condition below shows them.
Show BHS
Show BHS while held.
Show BHS on damage (body or limbs)
Show BHS after a hit. Duration below. 0 = off.
Shown duration (seconds)
How long BHS stays up after a hit. 0 = off.
Hide sooner if fully healed (sec)
If you heal to full during a damage flash, hide after this many seconds. 0 = hide at once.
Always show BHS when
Keep BHS up while any condition below is true. 0 on a slider turns that condition off.
Show BHS when body health below (%)
Show BHS while body health is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when limb health below (%)
Show BHS while any limb is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show just stamina when below (%)
Show only the stamina bar while stamina is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when psy health below (%)
Show BHS while psy is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when radiation above (%)
Show BHS while radiation is above this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when temp health
Show BHS while any limb has temporary (green) health.
Keep showing BHS for
Seconds to keep BHS up after conditions end. 0 = hide at once.
Hide status icons
Hide status icons by default. Only the icons you tick below will show.
Show status icons key (hold)
Show status icons while held.
Show radiation when not grey
Show the radiation icon when yellow or worse.
Show bleed when not grey
Show the bleed icon when yellow or worse.
Show hunger when not grey
Show the hunger icon when yellow or worse.
Show thirst when not grey
Show the thirst icon when yellow or worse.
Show sleep when not grey
Show the sleep icon when yellow or worse.
Hide grey status icon after
How long a mild grey icon stays visible. 0 = never show grey.
Thirst blur FX starts at yellow
Thirst blur starts at yellow instead of grey.
Minimap
Hide minimap by default
Hide the minimap until you hold the key.
Show minimap
Show the minimap while held.
Companion bars
Hide companion bars by default
Hide companion bars until you hold the key, they take a hit, or a condition below is true.
Show companion bars
Show companion bars while held.
Show companion bars on damage
Show companion bars after a companion is hit. 0 = off.
Shown duration (seconds)
How long companion bars stay up after a hit. 0 = off.
Always show companion bars when
Keep companion bars up while any condition below is true. 0 on a slider turns that condition off.
Show companion bars when health below (%)
Show companion bars while any companion is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show companion bars in combat
Show companion bars while a companion is in combat.
Keep showing companion bars for
Seconds to keep companion bars up after conditions end. 0 = hide at once.
